title: Rosetta Code tasks by concept
description: Rosetta Code tasks that demonstrate one language concept (or a small classic program) in dozens to hundreds of languages, each mapped to concept ids. rosettacode.org answers automated clients with HTTP 403, so every task was confirmed against the mirror repository acmeism/RosettaCodeData (Task/<Task-name>/00-META.yaml, whose 'from:' field gives the wiki URL); the link checker reports these as 'blocked'. Site-level and category pages are in side-by-side-references.
